import_notes: This is a staging dataset, not a direct POST payload.
The Tournament model requires an existing organisation_id and at least one active TournamentDivision.
Organisation IDs are null because they must be resolved against the target BeachVolleyballHub database.
Divisions are empty because the source calendars did not consistently publish tournament division offerings. Do not invent divisions.
Some entries and dates were transcribed from the preceding research summary and have not been independently re-verified in this export.
The NBVA season placeholder is not a confirmed individual tournament and must be split into actual events before import.
Some prior-source dates may conflict or have incomplete venue/round details; review source.review_required before importing.
No participation, registration, results, draw or payment data is included.
